note: Shape only (issue 72, ADR 0146). No host, account, key, ledger remote or feed exists. Nothing parses or enforces this file. It names the zones of the selected arrangement (ADRs 0141 to 0144) and keeps the control functions on a long-lived custody control host: it does NOT assume the optional, unimplemented serverless migration (issue 46). Every status is PENDING and unauthorized.

never_holds: provider launch credentials for the worker role

zones.identity: custodian-signer (separate uid the control uid cannot become; separate host preferred)
holds: the Ed25519 root key, generated on this host
zones.reachable_from: control_host over the Unix socket, one allowed peer uid

runs: outbox export to the private ledger
zones.identity: ledger-writer (own deploy key, one repository, not shared with CI, the App or a person)
zones.independent_checkpoint_copy: written by an identity neither the ledger writer nor the host root controls (decision recorded by the maintainer)

runs: one attempt inside the bubblewrap sandbox
zones.lifecycle: fresh launch from a pinned immutable ARM64 image per attempt, terminated after settlement, never stopped or reused (ADR 0142)
zones.adapter: custodian-worker-ec2 (not selectable in the daemon; not built into any deployment)

zones.read_by: benchmark consumer, anonymously, signed outputs only

separate_ci_runner: if any self-hosted CI runner exists it is on a different host outside custody credentials and data paths (ADR 0142)
